annotations.title: E-Rate invoice deadlines for one billed entity (BEN)

description: For an E-Rate coordinator: every funded FRN (funding year 2023 on) for one billed entity number with money still to collect (committed minus USAC authorized disbursements), its last date to invoice, whether the one-time 120-day extension is used, a status (last_chance = deadline passed but still inside the 15-day extension window; extend_now = deadline within 45 days; open; lost_or_waiver) and the exact action and date, plus the FY2026-2030 Category 2 budget left. Live from USAC Open Data (FRN Status qdmp-ygft, C2 Budget Tool 6brt-5pbv); rule 47 CFR 54.514 as amended by FCC 26-30. Nothing stored. Free.
